distribution.interpretation: Engineering trip-opportunity scenario transferred from territory-wide mechanised TCS. Walk mode is a counterfactual choice; neither total nor shares are locally observed or calibrated.

observation.atc_station_point_link_relationship: spatial candidate only; AADT is station aggregate, no directional link projection
observation.historical_development_period: 2023 ATC station AADT, descriptive reference only
observation.historical_held_out_period: 2024 ATC station AADT, descriptive reference only; no model calibration to 2023
observation.traffic_validation_status: NOT_AVAILABLE; internal capture scenario omits external flows; annual station AADT not equivalent to one-hour directed link PCE

trajectory.method: Viterbi candidate link-state sequence with emission distance/direction, directed official turn graph transition, bounded shortest route, explicit restart; fixed engineering penalties
trajectory.input: R1 private UrbanNav SPAN-CPT+IE reference positions (not raw GNSS)
trajectory.route_length_limit: sum of directed traversals within matched segments; restarts excluded
trajectory.inference_limit: One 2021 research-vehicle ground-truth trace; no representative speed, OD, mode share, or networkwide calibration claim
